description:
Pretty-print a JSON string with a chosen indent size.

Returns: Pretty-printed JSON string with the requested indent, or an error message if the input is invalid.
Example input: {"text":"{\"a\":1,\"b\":[2,3]}","indent":2}
On error, includes hint: Pass valid JSON as `text` (double-quoted keys/strings, no trailing commas). `indent` is an integer between 0 and 10.
name: json_format
title: Format JSON
